title: Origin story: Aladdin
description: Aladdin was a poor tailor's son in old tale-versions, recruited by a sorcerer to fetch a magic lamp from a sealed cave. Keeping the lamp, he won a princess, a palace, and the genie's service — losing all to the sorcerer and winning it back by wit, proving fortune favors the bold and clever.
